verdict.rationale: Persona's docs confirm manual review exists and that workflows can automate/reduce manual review time, with webhooks signaling when a user 'requires further review' — implying an orchestration layer around borderline cases. However, there's no direct evidence describing a manual review queue UI showing document images, extracted fields, and check results, nor explicit documentation that reviewer decisions are written back into the verification record. missing for 10: documentation of the review queue interface with full evidence bundle (images, extracted fields, checks), explicit reviewer decision write-back into the inquiry/account record.
